posts.title: When God’s Promises Meet the Storm
posts.description: Series: Stories of Prayer · No. 06 Acts 27 is interesting because it is one of the most detailed accounts of a shipwreck in ancient literature. Luke, who was evidently aboard the ship, gives intricate details about the wind, the navigation, the equipment, the sailors’ decisions, and the desperate measures they took to stay alive. posts.title: How Should Christians Think About Music?
posts.description: Series: Everyday Theology · No. 14 I’ve loved music for as long as I can remember. More than that, I’ve always been fascinated by it.
